job.description: Population analysis: which terminals log an unusually high number of error-level documents compared with the rest of the population.

detectors.detector_description: High error count for a terminal compared with the terminal population

ui_path: Observability > Machine learning > Anomaly detection > Jobs > Create job > data view 'App logs (workshop)' > Population. Population field terminal_id.keyword, metric Count (switch to high_count in Advanced), query level.keyword : (error or ERROR or critical or CRITICAL or fatal or FATAL), influencers terminal_id.keyword and store_id.keyword, bucket span 15m. Job ID mlws-terminal-population, group mlws.
teaches: Population jobs compare each entity with its peers instead of its own history, which suits thousands of terminals. A7: terminal T-0117-04 logs 30 'Printer offline' errors per minute. Forecasts are not available for population jobs.
